samples.title: Clack keyboard
messages: Use https://github.com/yjmtmtk/pixi-effects to make a video: a 12-second launch film for a fictional mechanical keyboard called "Clack" — the keyboard in 3D turning slowly under a soft spotlight, keys pressing in rhythm with a punchy beat, and the name slamming in at the end.
samples.alt: A mechanical keyboard in 3D turns under a spotlight; its keys light up on the beat and the name CLACK slams in.

samples.title: レシート撮るだけ app promo
messages: https://github.com/yjmtmtk/pixi-effects を使って動画を作って：縦型（1080×1920）15秒。家計簿アプリの新機能『レシート撮るだけ』の告知：スマホでレシートを撮ると金額が自動で飛んできてグラフが伸びる。
samples.alt: A vertical app promo: a phone scans a receipt, the total flies into a spending chart and the bars grow, then レシート撮るだけ in big type.

samples.title: 山水 ink wash
messages: 用 https://github.com/yjmtmtk/pixi-effects 做一个视频：15 秒，水墨风：墨滴在宣纸上晕开，变成远山和小船，最后书法字一笔一笔写出「山水」，配古筝。
samples.alt: An ink-wash painting: a drop of ink spreads into misty mountains, a fishing boat drifts, and the characters 山水 are brushed in stroke by stroke.

samples.title: Rain in five cities
messages: Usa https://github.com/yjmtmtk/pixi-effects para hacer un vídeo: 20 segundos, un gráfico de barras con la lluvia anual de cinco ciudades (Tokio 1530 mm, Londres 690, Bombay 2200, Seattle 960, El Cairo 25) que crece, se ordena de mayor a menor y termina con una frase que explica el resultado. Música tranquila.
samples.alt: A bar chart of yearly rain in five cities grows, sorts itself and ends on “Bombay gets 88 times more rain than Cairo”.

samples.title: Summer sale
messages: https://github.com/yjmtmtk/pixi-effects 를 사용해서 영상을 만들어 줘: 12초, 1080×1080 정사각형. 신나는 댄스 비트에 맞춰 'BIG', 'BOLD', 'BRIGHT' 세 단어가 박자마다 튀어나오고, 드롭에서 'SUMMER SALE 50%'가 번쩍이며 등장.
samples.alt: BIG, BOLD and BRIGHT hit on the beat, then SUMMER SALE 50% bursts out on the drop.

samples.title: Brewly app teaser
messages: Use https://github.com/yjmtmtk/pixi-effects to make a video: a 15-second launch teaser for a coffee-ordering app called Brewly.
Warmer colours, please, and let the phone screen show an order being placed.
Slow the ending down and finish on the logo with “Download free”.
The corners of the phone screen stick out past the phone's rounded frame. Please fix that.
samples.alt: A warm coffee-app teaser: the queue, an order placed on a phone, and the Brewly logo with Download free.

samples.title: Bread market
messages: https://github.com/yjmtmtk/pixi-effects を使って動画を作って：週末のパンのマルシェの告知、15秒。
もっとやわらかい手描き風にして、パンが焼き上がる湯気を入れて。
最後に日付と場所（11月23日・中央公園）を大きく出して、鐘の音で終わらせて。
samples.alt: A hand-drawn bread market notice: a loaf bakes with rising steam, the breads line up, and it ends on 11.23 at the central park with a bell.
